media.title: Smart Stores Using Naver Ads Saw 88% More Visitors
media.content: Research team's analysis found Smart Stores that ran Naver ads had 88% more visitors than stores that didn't, part of a broader study on the measurable impact of Naver's AI-driven ad tools on small sellers.

media.title: AI Adoption on Online Platforms Cuts Small Merchants' Cancellation and Return Rates
media.content: Study found that small merchants on platforms using AI-based tools saw lower order cancellation and return rates, reported by Kim Jung-eun.

media.title: Platform Upgrades, a Milestone for Small Business Growth
media.content: Presented at a National Assembly platform-merchant cooperation seminar on how pre-settlement services affect sellers' cash flow, finding they give sellers about 22 extra days of cash on average.

media.title: Kwangjang & Jipyong Hold Generative AI & Big Data Seminar
media.content: Covered the joint law-firm seminar on generative AI and big data, where the session on new technology and changes in corporate management was presented.

media.title: Naver Webtoon's AI Recommendations Ease Concentration on Popular Works
media.content: Research team's report cited by Naver Webtoon on its AI Curator recommendation system, showing the technology helps readers discover new works and eases concentration of attention on top creators.

media.title: [Op-Ed] Platform Regulation Overlooking Small Businesses
media.content: Published an opinion piece on the Fair Trade Commission's Platform Competition Promotion Act, arguing it could create reverse discrimination against domestic platforms and accelerate threats from foreign e-commerce to local small businesses.

media.title: Korea Standards Association Develops Digital Customer Experience Index
media.content: Jointly developed the Digital Customer Experience Index (DCXI) with the Korea Standards Association, aimed at ranking companies' digital customer experience by industry.

media.title: Naver Webtoon's 'Toon Raider' Anti-Piracy Research
media.content: Research presented at the Korean Media Management Association showing Naver Webtoon's AI-based 'Toon Raider' delays illegal distribution by approximately 25 days.

media.title: AI Regulation & Corporate Ethics
media.content: Interviewed by the ACRC on AI regulation trends, corporate compliance, fairness, transparency, and data privacy.

media.title: [Op-Ed] The Core of the Digital Platform Government Is the Cloud
media.content: Argued that cloud technology is essential to Korea's planned digital platform government, and commented on the public sector's slow adoption of private cloud services.

media.title: Naver AI Shopping Recommendations Raise Selection Rate for Unpopular Products 6.2x
media.content: Led the Korea University team behind the 'D-Commerce Report 2020,' finding that Naver's AI-based recommendation tool (AiTEMS) eases concentration of attention on a few 'superstar' products and helps lesser-known sellers get found.

media.title: [Op-Ed] AI Gives Small Business Owners an Opportunity and Should Be Actively Used
media.outlet: Electronic Times (전자신문; at the time, Sungkyunkwan University)
media.content: Analyzed data from Naver's AI-based 'Smart Around' recommendation service, arguing it helps new and less-known small shops — especially outside central commercial districts — win customers.
